### The Most Important Thing to Know and Do
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-august-29-2026.html
Passage: Hosea 6:6
Points:
- God does not merely possess love; love is the very essence of His character.
- Human beings were created specifically to be the objects of God's love, not out of any need on His part.
- Understanding how deeply God loves you establishes true self-worth and removes insecurity.
- The highest priority and duty in human life is knowing God and loving Him back.
- Starting each morning with a focus on knowing God better aligns your life with His purpose.

### God Will Show Up for You
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/god-will-show-up-for-you-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Hosea 6:3
Points:
- God's timing in answering prayers is as dependable as the morning dawn and seasonal rain.
- Lingering seasons of waiting often cause believers to doubt whether God hears them.
- Pressing on to know the Lord requires persistent prayer and trust in His character.
- Like winter and spring rains, God brings both deep soul-cleansing and fresh spiritual renewal.
- Remembering God's past faithfulness sustains hope when walking through spiritually dry seasons.
